name: 5th Dan

practical.title: Moon-Moo
practical.detail: 61 movements. Honours the 30th king of the Silla Dynasty, whose tomb is linked to the Sok Gul Am stone cave; the movements relate to the final digits of 661 AD.

practical.title: So San
practical.detail: 72 movements. Named after the monk Choi Hyong Ung, who organised monk soldiers who helped repel Japanese pirates in 1592.

practical.title: Yong-Gae
practical.detail: 49 movements. Named after General Yon Gae Somoon of the Koguryo Dynasty; the movements reference 649 AD.
